release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (DINION_IP_bullet_500_Data_sheet_enUS_63549469963.pdf). NTI-51022-A3S = 2MP bullet, 2.8-12 mm auto varifocal, with surface mount box (S); CPP7.3 platform. Distinct SKU from the older NTI-50022-A3S already in the dataset. Weight 1.3 kg without SMB (SMB 0.67 kg). Power consumption is given only as current (950 mA at 12 VDC, 750 mA at 24 VAC, 260 mA PoE), so consumption_w is left out.
